how-30-02-specimen.page: Press Inspect specimen. Move the magnifying lens over the animal, then tap 3 things you notice.
how-30-02-specimen.say: Press Inspect specimen. Move the magnifying lens over the animal, then tap three things you notice.

how-30-02-compare.page: Put the white sand under one tray and the dark soil under the other: drag them, or tap one, then a tray. Press Run the test. Then swap.
how-30-02-compare.say: Put the white sand under one tray and the dark soil under the other: drag them, or tap one, then a tray. Press Run the test. Then swap.

how-30-02-wall.page: First, make a prediction. Then brush the glowing stop: drag across it (or tap it again and again) until the photo shows.
how-30-02-wall.say: First, make a prediction. Then brush the glowing stop: drag across it (or tap it again and again) until the photo shows.

how-30-02-det.page: Pick 3 cards, one at a time. Tap the variation you see, then name its animal group. Predict if the variation helps, hurts, or makes no real difference, and see the real place.
how-30-02-det.say: Pick three cards, one at a time. Tap the variation you see, then name its animal group. Predict if the variation helps, hurts, or makes no real difference, and see the real place.

how-30-02-partc.page: Draw two individuals of the same Florida animal side by side. Show one variation between them, in a body part or a behavior. Label the variation on each one, and say which has the survival advantage.
how-30-02-partc.say: Draw two individuals of the same Florida animal side by side. Show one variation between them, in a body part or a behavior. Label the variation on each one, and say which has the survival advantage.
